reportSql:
SELECT
ml.external_id AS application_id,
ml.external_id AS client_loan_id,
lrs.installment AS installment_no,
lrs.duedate AS due_date,
COALESCE(m.principal_portion_derived, 0) AS principal,
COALESCE(m.interest_portion_derived, 0) AS interest,
0 AS other_charges,
COALESCE(cagg.overdue_amt, 0) AS overdue_charges,
COALESCE(m.penalty_charges_portion_derived, 0) AS penalty_charges,
COALESCE(cagg.other_amt, 0) AS fee_charges,
COALESCE(cagg.bounce_amt, 0) AS bounce_charges,
lt.amount AS amount,
lt.transaction_date AS paid_date,
eaot.effective_date_from AS investor_transfer_date,
eaot.settlement_date AS settlement_date,
pd.receipt_number AS client_utr_number,
CASE WHEN lrs.completed_derived = true THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS emi_closed,
CASE WHEN ml.loan_sub_status_id = 100 AND lt.transaction_date = ml.closedon_date THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS foreclosure,
'normal' AS payment_type,
eaot.external_id AS investor_utr_number,
lt.external_id AS reference_no,
pt.value AS instrument_type
FROM m_loan_transaction lt
JOIN m_loan ml ON ml.id = lt.loan_id
JOIN m_loan_transaction_repayment_schedule_mapping m ON m.loan_transaction_id = lt.id
JOIN m_loan_repayment_schedule lrs ON lrs.id = m.loan_repayment_schedule_id
LEFT JOIN m_payment_detail pd ON pd.id = lt.payment_detail_id
LEFT JOIN m_payment_type pt ON pt.id = pd.payment_type_id
LEFT JOIN (SELECT cpb.loan_transaction_id AS txn_id, cpb.installment_number AS inst_no, SUM(CASE WHEN c.name LIKE '%Bounce%' THEN cpb.amount ELSE 0 END) AS bounce_amt, SUM(CASE WHEN c.charge_time_enum = 9 THEN cpb.amount ELSE 0 END) AS overdue_amt, SUM(CASE WHEN c.name NOT LIKE '%Bounce%' AND c.charge_time_enum != 9 THEN cpb.amount ELSE 0 END) AS other_amt FROM m_loan_charge_paid_by cpb JOIN m_loan_charge lc ON lc.id = cpb.loan_charge_id JOIN m_charge c ON c.id = lc.charge_id GROUP BY cpb.loan_transaction_id, cpb.installment_number) cagg ON cagg.txn_id = lt.id AND cagg.inst_no = lrs.installment
LEFT JOIN (SELECT lm.loan_id AS loan_id, t.external_id AS external_id, t.settlement_date AS settlement_date, t.effective_date_from AS effective_date_from, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY lm.loan_id ORDER BY t.settlement_date DESC, t.id DESC) AS rn FROM m_external_asset_owner_transfer_loan_mapping lm JOIN m_external_asset_owner_transfer t ON t.id = lm.owner_transfer_id) eaot ON eaot.loan_id = ml.id AND eaot.rn = 1
WHERE lt.transaction_type_enum = 2 AND lt.is_reversed = false AND lt.transaction_date BETWEEN '${startDate}' AND '${endDate}'
AND ('${loanIds}' = '' OR '${loanIds}' = CONCAT('$', '{loanIds}') OR CONCAT(',', REPLACE('${loanIds}', ' ', ''), ',') LIKE CONCAT('%,', ml.id, ',%') OR CONCAT(',', REPLACE('${loanIds}', ' ', ''), ',') LIKE CONCAT('%,', ml.external_id, ',%'))
ORDER BY lt.transaction_date, ml.external_id, lrs.installment
